method: Known robot FK constrained RGB bundle adjustment (SHECAR Eq23 mechanism); fixed factory intrinsics, one fixed link6-to-RGB transform, unknown static scene points
repeatability_only: return views are excluded from fitting
feature_method: SIFT, mutual nearest-neighbor ratio0.70; fundamental RANSAC0.8px; at least4/5 train views; heldout observations never select training points
initialization: Existing unqualified single-pose camera transform; linear triangulation from training RGB and measured FK only; no depth
initial_point_gate: All available training camera depths 0.03..1m, training RMS reprojection below15px
candidate_gate: Converged; total rotation change<=25deg and translation<=75mm; no active parameter bound; each region heldout median<=2px, p90<=4px and pooled median at least30% lower than fixed-transform point-only fit
scope: Passing establishes reserved-view reprojection consistency only. No automated deployment, no physical calibration claim without uncertainty/observability and separate verification. No intrinsic, FK, safety or physics parameter is optimized.
